Builds a topologically sorted context window prompt by querying the graph for
initial matches and then walking the structural graph up to the root Policies, returning
the optimal token-budgeted prompt context.

Example:
  zqk system prompt-builder "authentication mechanisms" --budget 4000

Usage:
  zqk system prompt-builder [query] [flags]

Flags:
      --budget int   Maximum token budget for the generated prompt context (default 3000)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
